description: Variation of condition 4 to change the opening hours of the shop to 24 hours and condition 5 to change the operational times of the petrol pumps to 24 hours except for pumps 1 to 4 which shall not operate between the hours of 11.00pm and 6.00am of planning permission 01137/403 405/P29 (P/2016/1527) approved 29/06/2016 for the variation of condition 3 to change the opening hours from 07:00 am to 06:00 am following planning permission 01137/403 405/P23 (H/0006/5173) dated 14/12/1983 for erection of petrol service station with car servicing.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.
Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Reason: To ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
Condition : 3 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the site outside the hours of 07:00 � 23:00.
Reason: 
1. In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
2. To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality. 
Condition : 4 - The on-site car wash shall not be used outside the hours of 07:00 � 23:00.
Reason:
1. In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties. 
2. To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality.
Condition : 5 - The on-site shop shall be permitted to operate on a 24-hour basis.
Reason: 
1. In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
2. To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality.
Condition : 6 - The filling of vehicles with petrol and the associated receipt of payment with the exception of pumps 1, 2, 3 and 4 shall be permitted to operate on a 24-hour basis.
Reason: In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties and to ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality.
Condition : 7 - All boundary walls shall be maintained at their present height, and the front boundary enclosure shall not exceed 750mm from footpath level.
Reason: So as to ensure adequate sight lines for traffic.
Condition : 8 - The fuel pumps and openings to the fuel storage tanks shall be not less than 4.25m behind the highway boundary.
Reason: To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety on the adjacent highway.
Condition : 9 - Vehicles shall not be sold or displayed on the forecourt of this petrol filling station.
Reason: To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the free flow of traffic or conditions of general safety on the adjacent highway.
Condition : 10 - The development hereby permitted shall be implemented and operated in full accordance with the details, recommendations, and mitigation measures set out in the Operational Management Statement prepared by Adcock associates submitted in support of the application.
The approved noise mitigation measures shall be retained, maintained, and operated as approved for the lifetime of the development, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Reason: To protect the amenity of nearby occupiers and the surrounding area from noise disturbance.
Condition : 11 - The noise level emitted during operation of the public address system shall not exceed 39dB LAeqT, with a maximum noise level 48dB LAfmax at the fa�ade of the nearest noise sensitive receptor between the hours of 23:00 to 07:00.  
Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise.  
Condition : 12 - Any tyre inflation equipment or vacuum cleaners shall not be used outside the hours of 07:00 � 23:00.
Reason:
1. In order to safeguard the amenities of adjoining residential properties.
2. To ensure that the proposed development does not prejudice the amenities of the locality.
